stem: In the excerpt from Kokoro, which detail does the author include to connect the setting to a theme about the significance of change?

options.label: A
options.text: The narrator’s friend uses a traditional form of transportation to get to a modern university.

options.label: B
options.text: Sensei lends the narrator old books to read, but the narrator goes to the library for other publications.

options.label: C
options.text: Rather than giving the narrator academic guidance, Sensei advises the narrator to visit his university professors.

options.label: D
options.text: The narrator makes progress with his thesis as spring arrives and trees begin to blossom.
